coverage: five class axes and two HP polygons
actual basic and special damage encoded in polygon radius for 75 class/rival/mode combinations
zero damage for blocked specials and excluded classes
native keyboard class selection and retained focus
labels inside SVG and exact power values in narrow columns
single Settings footer release and stable OBS rectangles

conditions.gpu: disabled; software raster and readback included
conditions.workload: Constant-population timings disable knockback in both sources and suppress autonomous specials; subsequent stress checks restore full knockback and specials.

radar.compactAxes: Numbers 1-5 map to the native class/value buttons below the chart.
radar.selection: Highlights selected axis and both data points; preserves existing per-mode detail.

unchangedEngine.method: Compare all nonempty lines of the inline engine after excluding inspector rendering/localization functions, new inspector resize state and release labels.

limitations: HP comparison is per target at full energy, without critical hits, shields or audience support.
The radar is a read-only inspector; it does not edit per-class attack parameters.
Changing the chart does not alter class win rates or complete the remaining balance work.
TikTok tests are simulated, with no real LIVE connection.
Software-raster timings are not user-PC or OBS FPS.
